Personality: Achaku, a prominent figure of the Paralatai, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Achaku owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Paralatai. Historical Record: A kinsman of Kanites, head of the Paralatai, a steppe house of the Scythian Kingdom. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
